links.outcome: Diagnostic helpfulness ratings and correct diagnosis in differential, CNS-Obsidian vs GPT-4o, in randomized deployment trial
links.effect: Positive ratings 40.62% vs 57.89% (P = .230); correct diagnosis in differential 59.38% vs 65.79% (P = .626); 70 consultations evaluated
links.quote: Both models included correct diagnosis in approximately 60% of cases (59.38% vs 65.79%, P = .626).

links.outcome: Domain VLM accuracy on synthetic versus human-generated questions compared with GPT-4o
links.effect: Matched GPT-4o on synthetic questions (76.13% vs 77.54%, P = .235) but only 46.81% on human-generated questions vs GPT-4o's 65.70% (P < 10-15)
links.quote: CNS-Obsidian matched GPT-4o on synthetic questions (76.13% vs 77.54%, P = .235), but only achieved 46.81% accuracy on human-generated questions vs GPT-4o's 65.70% (P < 10-15).

unlisted_practices: Training domain-specific vision-language model on curated peer-reviewed literature instead of general internet data

screen.reason: Evaluates a domain-specific vision-language model (CNS-Obsidian) compared to GPT-4o in a randomized deployment trial among neurosurgeons. It compares two AI models rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
